name: circleftp-jellyfin
description: Web app that proxies Circle FTP and downloads titles straight into a Jellyfin library

scripts.build: npm run build -w @cfj/shared && npm run build -w @cfj/server && npm run build -w @cfj/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @cfj/server" "npm run dev -w @cfj/web"
